goal: Refactor CheckoutPage.tsx state management by moving 15+ React states, Supabase fetch methods, and form validation functions into a dedicated custom hook `useCheckoutOrchestrator.ts` to follow MVVM patterns.
constraints: No any or as any tiplemeleri allowed.
Do not break existing checkout page workflows (customer info, address selection, review, payment iframe).
known_context: CheckoutPage.tsx currently holds 15+ React states and passes all of them to useCheckoutPayment hook, creating a massive parameter surface.

risks.description: Refactoring state hooks could break references or callback timings in payment polling.

options.title: Decouple state via useCheckoutOrchestrator hook
options.reason: Successfully extracts UI state orchestration from checkout page, aligning with CONTEXT.md Kural 9.

options.title: Keep state inline in CheckoutPage.tsx
options.reason: Violates MVVM principle and maintains 15+ parameters smell on useCheckoutPayment.

recommendation: Option A is highly recommended to improve readability, maintainability, and clean architecture.

traces.finding: Found 15+ separate react state declarations and direct Supabase load calls.
